jobs.prompt: A single isolated building asset for a mobile game village map, nothing else in the image. Camera (identical for every building in the set): three-quarter front view from slightly above, about 30 degrees elevation, the front faces the viewer and the building is turned a little so its right side is also visible, near-orthographic with no wide-angle distortion. Footprint (identical for every building in the set): the building stands on one thin rounded patch of forest ground, short dull-green grass with a packed-earth rim; the patch is centered, spans about 84% of the image width, and its front edge sits about 8% above the bottom of the image. Everything fits on the patch with a small margin on all sides; nothing is cropped. Subject: a shabby old two-storey log office of a small-time moneylender. Weathered grey-brown logs that lean a little, a patched bark-shingle roof with moss and one missing shingle, a bent tin stovepipe. The ground floor is boarded shut with planks; a rickety outside wooden staircase on the left climbs to the second-floor door. On the second floor one wide window with yellowish lantern light behind crooked twig blinds, and a blank faded mustard-yellow wooden signboard hanging slightly askew from a rope. A rain barrel and an old stump stool by the wall. Tired and worn but tidy enough to be believable; no trash piles. World rule: this is a cozy storybook forest village where small woodland animals live, like an Animal Crossing village, and everything is built by hand from forest materials: logs, bark, tree hollows, big roots, moss, river stones, leaf-thatched or bark-shingle roofs, woven twigs, vines, lanterns, acorn ornaments. The building's real-world function must read at a glance from its silhouette and props, because it is a real institution made out of forest materials (leaf documents, acorn-cap queue tokens, wooden sign plates). The dark humour comes from that contrast, not from horror. No modern equipment or materials at all: no air conditioners, no utility meters, no aluminium frames, no water tanks, no cables or wires, no concrete, no plastic, no neon, no screens, no vehicles. No faces on objects, no hearts, no sparkles, no magic glow. No characters, no animals, no people. Every signboard, banner, notice and plate is a BLANK plain wooden plate or blank leaf: absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols anywhere. Style: pastel soft cel shading, smooth colour blocks, soft two-tone cel shadows in a darker tone of the same hue, a thin light highlight on top-left edges, no black outline (edges are a slightly darker tone of the fill colour), no photo texture, no watercolor bleed, no paper grain, no glossy 3D render. Single light from the top-left, shadows fall to the lower right and stay on the building and ground patch only. Bold simple silhouette made of a few large shapes so it stays readable when shrunk to 100 pixels wide; foliage is drawn as a few big rounded clumps, not many small leaves. Colours are slightly muted (dull sage and moss greens, warm browns, soft greys) and a little duller than the character, so a bright orange character standing in front always pops. Use the reference image ONLY for its rendering style (pastel soft cel shading, softness of shadows, edge treatment). Do not draw the chipmunk or any character. Background: one perfectly flat, uniform, pure chroma magenta (#FF00FF) filling the whole image, no gradient, no texture, no vignette, no floor line, no cast shadow on the background. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the subject.
